name: Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund
summary: Subsidies for mobility and assistive devices, transport, and home healthcare items for eligible seniors.

name: Pioneer Generation Package
summary: Healthcare subsidies and MediSave top-ups for eligible Pioneer Generation seniors.

name: Merdeka Generation Package
summary: Outpatient care subsidies, MediSave top-ups, and related support for eligible Merdeka Generation seniors.

name: MediSave500/700 for Chronic Disease Management Programme
summary: Allows MediSave use for outpatient treatment of approved chronic conditions under CDMP, subject to current withdrawal limits.

name: Community Health Assist Scheme
eligibility_hints: CHAS, Pioneer Generation, or Merdeka Generation card
summary: Subsidies for medical and dental care at participating clinics.

name: Home Caregiving Grant
summary: Monthly cash payout to support caregiving expenses for eligible persons with permanent moderate disability.

name: CareShield Life / ElderShield
eligibility_hints: unable to perform activities of daily living
summary: Long-term care insurance payouts for eligible people with severe disability.

name: Assistive Technology Fund
summary: Subsidies for assistive technology devices for eligible persons with disabilities.

name: Caregivers Training Grant
eligibility_hints: care recipient is Singapore Citizen or PR
aged 65 and older or has disability
summary: Subsidises approved courses for caregivers to learn skills to better care for their loved ones.

name: ElderFund
eligibility_hints: requires full assistance with at least three activities of daily living
summary: Discretionary monthly cash support for lower-income Singapore Citizens with severe disability and long-term care needs.

name: Interim Disability Assistance Programme for the Elderly
eligibility_hints: scheme eligibility must be verified with AIC
summary: Monthly cash assistance for eligible older Singaporeans with severe disabilities to help manage care costs.

name: MediSave Care
eligibility_hints: Singapore Citizen or PR aged 30 and above
requires full assistance with at least three activities of daily living
summary: Monthly MediSave cash withdrawals for eligible severely disabled Singapore Citizens or PRs to help with long-term care costs.

name: MediFund
eligibility_hints: difficulty paying after subsidies, insurance, and MediSave
summary: Safety-net assistance for Singapore Citizens who face difficulty paying remaining medical bills after subsidies, insurance, and MediSave.

name: MediShield Life
summary: Basic national health insurance for Singapore Citizens and PRs that helps pay for large hospital bills and selected costly outpatient treatments.

name: Enhanced Home Personal Care Subsidies
eligibility_hints: Singapore Citizen or PR for subsidies
doctor, polyclinic, hospital, or AIC Link referral
summary: Means-tested subsidies may apply for eligible seniors using Enhanced Home Personal Care services for daily care support at home.

name: Home Therapy Subsidies
eligibility_hints: Singapore Citizen or PR for subsidies
doctor, polyclinic, hospital, or AIC Link referral
summary: Means-tested subsidies may apply for eligible seniors who need physiotherapy, occupational therapy, or speech therapy at home.

name: Day Care and Dementia Day Care Subsidies
eligibility_hints: Singapore Citizen or PR for subsidies
doctor, polyclinic, hospital, or AIC Link referral
summary: Means-tested subsidies may apply for eligible seniors attending day care or dementia day care services.
